name: claude-native-timestamps
description: Shows the date and time of each message inside the native Claude Code chat panel.

ccNativeTs.timeZone.markdownDescription: Time zone for the labels: `local` (system time zone, default), `UTC`, an IANA name such as `Europe/Berlin` or `Asia/Tokyo`, or a fixed offset such as `UTC+9` or `UTC-03:30`.

ccNativeTs.transcriptsDir.markdownDescription: Folder with Claude Code session transcripts (`*.jsonl` in per-project subfolders). Empty = `~/.claude/projects`.

ccNativeTs.autoPatch.description: Re-apply the patch automatically on startup (needed after every Claude Code update).
